summary: Full backend + frontend regression for new super-admin-gated Admin AI (chat/edit/image), Benefits Quiz, and custom sections. 11/11 backend pytest pass. Frontend: Quiz 9 questions + feedback + score + restart all work (data-testids present and correct). Admin AI button is visible to super admin, opens panel, created a new 'Care Tips' custom section via NL prompt and it rendered on public home via [data-testid^=custom-section-] (id custom-section-care-tips). AI image generation (gpt-image-1) returned a servable image in ~30s shown with [data-testid^=admin-ai-image-]. Quiz editor in dashboard: edited quiz.title, Save all changes propagated to public /#quiz [data-testid=quiz-title]. 401 for anon and 403/401 for member-token verified on /api/admin/ai, /api/admin/ai-edit, /api/admin/ai-edit/undo, /api/admin/ai/email/send. Test custom section was cleaned up via PUT /api/site; quiz title restored.
critical_code_review_comments: default_site quiz questions use key 'q' and 'answer', while the AI edit guidance comments mention 'question' and 'correctIndex'. Pick one schema and align the AI prompt docs so AI-generated quiz edits stay consistent.
server.py is now ~3380 lines and growing — splitting admin/ai, admin/site, auth into routers would ease review.

No explicit non-super admin frontend test was executable because creating a non-super admin with 2FA via UI is heavy; the hidden-when-not-super guard was verified by reading me?.isSuper gating in AdminDashboard.jsx and the backend 401 case through unauth requests. Consider seeding a non-super admin for test harnesses.
/api/admin/ai edit returns a 'snapshot' field that the UI's Undo flow depends on; keep this contract stable.
seed_data_creation: Member TEST_super_gate_*@example.com created transiently in backend tests for 403 verification; one AI-created custom section ('care-tips') was created in UI test and removed afterwards via PUT /api/site. Quiz title was restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_admin_ai_super_gating.py. Login: POST /api/admin/login then /api/admin/2fa/login (twoFactorToken MUST be in both JSON body and Authorization: Bearer header). Quiz questions schema uses keys {q, options, answer, gem, color, kicker, title}. Admin AI endpoints are require_super gated — a plain admin token still 403s. /api/admin/ai kind='edit' returns {applied, failed, snapshot, summary}; /api/admin/ai-edit/undo requires body {snapshot}. Image generation via kind='image' takes 20-60s and returns {kind:'image', images:[...], text}. The AIWriter component renders images with data-testid admin-ai-image-N. Custom sections render on public home with data-testid=custom-section-<id>.
